ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is for Off-campus B.S. in HORT students only. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $343.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
